description:

Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Eternal Scourge token, adding {C}{C}.
When the Eternal Scourge token dies, Dross Harvester triggers, causing you to gain 2 life
Cast Eternal Scourge from exile by paying {3}.
Repeat.
